extDescription.message: Lets Her, the assistant in Aide, work in tabs it opens in your Chrome, with your sign-ins. It never sees your other tabs.

statusMissing.message: Not set up on this computer

hintMissing.message: Install Aide and turn on Her for this computer.

hintStandby.message: Her uses another browser or profile.

hintNotOpen.message: Open Aide to let Her use this browser.

offerNote.message: Her will be able to read and use this tab.

titleMissing.message: Aide is not set up on this computer

hintStuck.message: Opening Aide repairs the connection. Then retry.

hintUpdateExtension.message: It reconnects by itself afterwards, and your tabs stay as they are.

hintUpdateHer.message: Open it and update. It reconnects by itself afterwards.

hintNoAnswer.message: Reloading the extension brings it back. Your tabs stay as they are.
